class.name: Walker
class.brief_description: A walker's tuning, shown in the inspector.

method.name: walk
method.description: Moves the walker along [code]direction[/code] (normalised by the caller) for [code]time[/code] seconds at its speed, counts one step, and emits [code]arrived[/code] with the step count. Answers the distance moved (m).

class.name: Ticker
class.brief_description: A node that counts the engine's calls into its virtual overrides.

members.member: The keycode of the last key event [code]_input[/code] received; 0 before one.

method.name: distance
method.description: Metres covered at [code]speed[/code] (m/s) over [code]time[/code] (s).

method.name: apply
method.description: [code]f(x)[/code] as a float, through Callable.call.

method.name: call_float
method.description: [code]target.method(x)[/code] as a float, through Object.call.

method.name: is_walker
method.description: Whether [code]obj[/code] is a Walker, or a script that extends one.

method.name: speed_of
method.description: The walker's speed (m/s); -1 for null.

method.name: scratch
method.description: Takes [code]bytes[/code] of temp memory and touches it; the call gives it back when it returns.

method.name: temp_in_use
method.description: Bytes of temp memory held now, between calls.

class.name: ExamplePlugin
class.brief_description: The editor plugin the extension adds to the editor.

class.name: Bag
class.brief_description: A bag of four numbered slots, read and written as the properties [code]slot_0[/code] to [code]slot_3[/code].

method.name: score
method.description: The script's [code]_score(x)[/code], or -1 when the script has none.

method.name: has_marks
method.description: Whether the bag carries every flag in [code]marks[/code].

method.name: total
method.description: The sum of [code]xs[/code]. An untyped call may pass an Array, which arrives converted.

method.name: doubled
method.description: A copy of [code]xs[/code] with every element doubled. [code]xs[/code] is borrowed, so the copy is written, not [code]xs[/code].

method.name: squares
method.description: The squares of 0 to [code]n - 1[/code], built in an Odin slice and handed over in one copy.

method.name: colors
method.description: The names of the bag's flags.

method.name: vowels
method.description: The vowels in [code]s[/code], read in place, counting accented ones.

method.name: second
method.description: Element 1 of [code]xs[/code], or null when it has none.

method.name: redden
method.description: Sets the red of every pixel of [code]img[/code], an RGBA8 image, to full, written in place. Any other format is left alone.

method.name: file_sum
method.description: The sum of the bytes of the file at [code]path[/code], read 64 at a time; -1 when it cannot be opened.

method.name: shout
method.description: [code]s[/code], then "!¡", '?' and [code]s[/code] again, appended in place to one new String.

method.name: parallel_sum
method.description: The sum of 0 to [code]n - 1[/code], in chunks spread over the engine's worker threads.

method.name: worker_temp_freed
method.description: Whether worker threads give back the temp memory a task used: one group takes 8 MiB of temp per call, twice the default block, then a second group finds every worker's temp arena empty and no bigger than one default block.

method.name: task_text
method.description: The length of "task <x>", formatted on a worker thread in that thread's temp memory.

method.name: misuse_task
method.description: Calls [code]ExampleTally.bump[/code] from a worker task, which tasks must not do. A debug build stops the process there, as example/build.sh checks; it does not return.

method.name: bump_all
method.description: Adds 1 to every int element of [code]xs[/code] in place, which the caller sees, as with [code]xs[i] += 1[/code] in GDScript. False, with [code]xs[/code] untouched, when it is typed or read-only.

method.name: range_of
method.description: The ints 0 to [code]n - 1[/code] in a new Array, built in an Odin slice and copied over in one resize.

method.name: weighted
method.description: The sum of key times value over the int entries of [code]d[/code].

method.name: typed_range
method.description: The ints 0 to [code]n - 1[/code] in a new Array[int].

method.name: typed_words
method.description: ["a", "bc"] as a new Array[String].

method.name: typed_nodes
method.description: [code]n[/code] nulls in a new Array[Node].

method.name: typed_bump
method.description: Adds 1 to every element of the Array[int] [code]xs[/code] in place. False, with [code]xs[/code] untouched, for any other Array.

method.name: typed_shout
method.description: Appends "!" to every element of the Array[String] [code]xs[/code] in place. False, with [code]xs[/code] untouched, for any other Array.

method.name: named
method.description: [code]s[/code] made into a StringName from Odin text.

method.name: pathed
method.description: [code]s[/code] made into a NodePath from Odin text.

method.name: find_2d
method.description: Whether [code]root[/code] has a Node2D at [code]path[/code].

method.name: find_ghost
method.description: The [code]seen[/code] of the Ghost at [code]path[/code] from [code]root[/code], or -1 when there is none.

method.name: ghost_seen
method.description: The [code]seen[/code] of the Ghost at the fixed path "Sprite/Ghost", or -1, through an interned NodePath; and whether "Sprite" is a Node2D the same way.

method.name: is_jump
method.description: Whether [code]name[/code] is "jump", compared against an interned name; and the interned name itself, the same one on every call.

method.name: texts
method.description: [code]name[/code] and [code]path[/code] as Odin text, joined by "|".

method.name: say
method.description: Prints "Bag says [code]n[/code]" to the engine's output.

method.name: adder
method.description: A Callable [code]c[/code] whose [code]c.call(x)[/code] adds [code]x * n[/code] to [code]proc_total[/code].

method.name: slot_adder
method.description: A Callable [code]c[/code] whose [code]c.call(x)[/code] adds [code]x[/code] to this bag's slot [code]slot[/code].

method.name: defer
method.description: At the end of the frame, adds [code]n[/code] to [code]proc_total[/code] and to slot 2.

method.name: proc_total
method.description: [code]proc_total[/code], a static method.

method.name: dict_squares
method.description: {0: 0, 1: 1, 2: 4...} up to [code]n - 1[/code], untyped.

method.name: dict_words
method.description: {"a": 3, "bc": 2} as a Dictionary[String, int], from a key list that repeats "a".

method.name: dict_loose
method.description: {1: "x", 2: null} as a Dictionary[int, Variant].

method.name: load_kinds
method.description: Which of Resource, Texture2D and Walker [code]load[/code] finds at [code]path[/code], as the bits 1, 2 and 4.

method.name: load_speed
method.description: The speed of the Walker resource at [code]path[/code], or -1 when there is none.

method.name: greet
method.description: "hi, [code]name[/code]" with its byte count: Odin strings in and out, copied at the call boundary.

method.name: kinds
method.description: [code]label[/code], then the Variant type of each extra argument: a vararg method.

method.name: describe
method.description: Sets [code]node[/code]'s editor description from Odin text: a cached constant for [code]n[/code] = 0, else text built at run time. Answers the live temp_text count, and for [code]n[/code] != 0 first the count inside a nested engine-call scope times 10: 0, or 21 when the nested scope's own text ended with it.

method.name: text_size
method.description: [code]s[/code]'s length, or -1 when it is empty, through the generated [code]string_length[/code] and [code]string_is_empty[/code].

method.name: same_text
method.description: Whether [code]a[/code] and [code]b[/code] are equal by [code]string_equal[/code], as bit 0, and [code]a[/code] matches [code]b[/code]'s text by [code]string_equal_text[/code], as bit 1.

method.name: lone_byte_matches
method.description: Whether "é" matches the lone byte 0xE9, its code but invalid UTF-8; it must not. GDScript cannot pass invalid UTF-8, so the text is fixed here.

method.name: text_ends
method.description: Whether [code]s[/code] begins with [code]part[/code]'s text, as bit 0, and ends with it, as bit 1: by [code]string_begins_with_text[/code] and [code]string_ends_with_text[/code]. Bits 2 and 3 are the same ignoring case.

method.name: which
method.description: The index of [code]s[/code] among a fixed set of names by [code]string_which[/code], or -1. "jump" and "jo-p" share a key, so the full compare picks between them; "rin", "jamp" and "jo本p" match a key and no name.

method.name: which_name
method.description: The index of [code]name[/code] among a fixed set of names by [code]name_which[/code], or -1.

method.name: replaced_ops
method.description: The String procs that replace engine methods, on [code]s[/code] and [code]part[/code]: find, rfind, findn and rfindn from [code]from[/code], then contains, containsn, count and countn from [code]from[/code] to [code]to[/code], begins_with and ends_with, booleans as 0 or 1, then casecmp_to and nocasecmp_to. test.gd builds the same array from the engine's methods.

method.name: replaced_strs
method.description: The String procs that replace engine methods and make Strings: replace and replacen of [code]part[/code] by [code]with[/code] in [code]s[/code], then the parts of split on [code]part[/code]. test.gd builds the same array from the engine's.

method.name: find_text
method.description: Where [code]part[/code]'s text first appears in [code]s[/code] at or after [code]from[/code], by [code]string_find_text[/code].

method.name: has_text
method.description: Whether [code]part[/code]'s text appears in [code]s[/code], by [code]string_contains_text[/code].

method.name: rfind_text
method.description: Where [code]part[/code]'s text last appears in [code]s[/code] at or before [code]from[/code], by [code]string_rfind_text[/code].

method.name: nocase
method.description: The case-insensitive compares of [code]part[/code]'s text against [code]s[/code], packed for one call: bits 0 to 15 hold [code]string_findn_text[/code] + 1, bits 16 to 31 [code]string_rfindn_text[/code] + 1, bit 32 [code]string_containsn_text[/code] and bit 33 [code]string_equal_text_nocase[/code].

method.name: count_text
method.description: [code]string_count_text[/code] of [code]part[/code]'s text in [code]s[/code] between [code]from[/code] and [code]to[/code] in bits 0 to 31, and [code]string_countn_text[/code] in bits 32 and up.

method.name: replace_text
method.description: [code]s[/code] with [code]part[/code]'s text replaced by [code]with[/code]'s, by [code]string_replacen_text[/code] when [code]nocase[/code], else [code]string_replace_text[/code].

method.name: split_text
method.description: [code]s[/code] split on [code]part[/code]'s text by [code]string_split_text[/code].

method.name: split_lengths
method.description: The length of each part of [code]s[/code] split on [code]part[/code]'s text, read through [code]string_split_parts[/code].

method.name: split_strip
method.description: The parts of [code]s[/code] split on [code]part[/code]'s text, each trimmed by [code]runes_strip_edges[/code] and made a String by [code]string_of_runes[/code].

method.name: part_ints
method.description: [code]runes_to_int[/code] of each part of [code]s[/code] split on [code]part[/code]'s text.

method.name: part_is
method.description: For each part of [code]s[/code] split on [code]part[/code]'s text, whether it is [code]word[/code]'s text by [code]runes_equal_text[/code] in bit 0 and by [code]runes_equal_text_nocase[/code] in bit 1.

method.name: part_floats
method.description: [code]runes_to_float[/code] of each part of [code]s[/code] split on [code]part[/code]'s text.

method.name: int_texts
method.description: [code]string_of_int[/code] of each number.

method.name: float_texts
method.description: [code]string_of_float[/code] of each number.

method.name: real_texts
method.description: [code]string_of_real[/code] of each number.

method.name: lib_path
method.description: This library's path, as the engine reports it.

method.name: lookup
method.description: [code]d[key][/code], or "missing" when [code]d[/code] has no such key.

method.name: tally
method.description: Counts [code]word[/code] in [code]d[/code], a Dictionary of words to counts, through an Odin string key. False when [code]d[/code] does not take it.

method.name: put
method.description: [code]d[key] = value[/code], or false when [code]d[/code] does not take them.

method.name: member
method.description: [code]v[key][/code] for any Variant, or "missing".

method.name: temp_live
method.description: The live temp_text count between calls: 0.

method.name: count
method.description: How many arguments it got: a static vararg method with no other parameters.

members.member: Flags, a checklist in the inspector.
An unsigned byte, which reads back past 127.
Shown in the inspector only while [code]show_note[/code] is set.
An object of its own, made with the bag and released with it.

class.name: Tally
class.brief_description: An Object the extension makes once and gives the engine as the singleton [code]ExampleTally[/code].

method.name: bump
method.description: Calls so far, counting this one.

class.name: Ghost
class.brief_description: A Node that exists only in a running game: in the editor its instances are placeholders.

method.name: typed_ghosts
method.description: [code]g[/code], [code]n[/code] times, in a new Array[Ghost]: a typed Array of a registered class.

method.name: ghost_total
method.description: The sum of [code]seen[/code] over the Array[Ghost] [code]xs[/code]; -1 for any other Array.
